_meta.description: Canned sample input for Pensieve Phase 0 dry-run. Mirrors the eventual Graph /me/todo/lists?$expand=tasks shape, augmented with strand_catalog + connect goal context. Connect goals come from data/connect-goals.json (Enrich-Memories.ps1 loads both files).
_meta.v2_notes: v2 adds connect_goal_ids to each strand. Memory enrichment is expected to inherit goal alignment from strand AND independently propose alignment based on task content.

strand_catalog.description: Drafting + reviewing responses to JET RFIs under DORA. Article-grounded, evidence-backed. Coordinates with Azure/M365 product owners.

Argus product development: regulator personas, narrative engine, UK CTP portal, scheduled workflows. Local prototype, packaged Windows app.
Building Pensieve itself — To-Do enrichment + memory + Reverie calendar blocks. Internal productivity multiplier for AI program.
Structured AI transformation program for CISO GRC. Idea intake, triage, pilot cohorts, governance docs.
Preparing for 1:1s with directs and manager. Team agenda items. Trust-building / cross-org coordination prep.
Weekly structured update to your manager, timed to inform the leadership sync that follows. Sample of a recurring writing strand that maps to multiple Connect goals.
Capturing accomplishments for Connect / promo case. H1 self-reflection. Stack rank moments. Synapse Promo Coach output target.
AI Foundry deep-dives, Azure OpenAI new model rollouts, agent-framework videos. Feeds the AI program work.
Procurement, invoices, expense reports, MSFT housekeeping. Low-impact but unavoidable.
Non-work tasks that accidentally land in the same To-Do list. Should NOT be enriched as work memories.
